name_story.story: Khairul can be understood through the Arabic form خَيْرُ الْخَلْق, whose central sense is khairul; best of creation (malay form). Khairul is the Malay form of Arabic خَيْرُ الْخَلْق (Khayr al-Khalq), meaning 'best of creation'.

faq.a: Khairul is associated with the Arabic form خَيْرُ الْخَلْق, whose core sense is khairul; best of creation (malay form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Khairul?
faq.a: Khairul is associated with Arabic. Khairul is the Malay form of Arabic خَيْرُ الْخَلْق (Khayr al-Khalq), meaning 'best of creation'.
Yes — the underlying form خَيْرُ الْخَلْق is Arabic.
Khairul can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Khairul should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Khayr al-Khalq is a compound of Arabic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Khairul mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Khairul is rendered خیر الخلق and carries the sense خیر الخلق، مخلوق میں بہترین.

faq.q: What does Khairul mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Khairul is rendered خیرالخلق and carries the sense خیرالخلق، بهترین آفریدگان.
A romanized syllable approximation is khai-rul. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Khairul?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Khairul, khairul. Script forms are خير الخلق, خَيْرُ الْخَلْق, خیر الخلق, خیرالخلق, ख़ैरुल.

faq.q: Is Khairul a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
